observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 30 stand in the left margin and the locator «p 191.» (L12, beside the head of chapter 54) in the right margin; the locator is printed without the point after p. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of chapter 54: 15 stands beside the first line of the title, 20 beside L17. The signature 17 stands at the foot of the page, at the right.

body L12: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXII) read «129, marg., numerus paginae textus, male impressus, est 194.»; the printed «p 191.» is kept. The locator before it is «p. 193.» (p. 128).
body L12-L14: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type; «CAPUT LIV.» and the two lines of the title are centred.
body L1: «merōn» (the end of nychthemerōn, divided from p. 128) is printed with a macron over the o.
body L19: a speck stands after «complectitur;» at the height of the tops of the letters; it is not a sign.
body L15, L24, L25: specks stand in the right margin beside the lines; they are not signs.
notes_left L3-L5: «365ᵈ 5ʰ 46ᵐ 24ˢ», «13ᵐ 36ˢ» and «24ʰ 1ᵐ 36ˢ» are written with small raised italic d, h, m and s.

notes_left L8, L10: the iota after the tau of «σχηματισμοί» (L8) is printed broken, like a colon; in «ὄψεις» (L10) the omicron is printed broken, open at the right, and its breathing and accent are printed together as one bar.
notes_left L11, L12: the opening parentheses of «(6)» and «(7)» are printed short.
notes_right L3: a slanting speck stands under the second omicron of «Ἑξάγωνον»; it is not a sign.
notes_right L4-L5: note 10 refers to «l. 22»; in the count of the lines the words praeter coniunctionem of the body stand in line 20 (L17).
notes_right L10: a short speck stands before «seu» at the height of the tops of the letters; it is not a sign.
body L17, L18: a speck stands between the lines, under the c of «aspectus» (L17) and over the i of «videlicet» (L18); it is not an accent.
notes_left L12: a speck stands under the first a of «quadra-»; it is not a sign.
notes_right L5, L12: the second c of «Bouché-Leclercq» is printed broken; in «1622» the 6 is printed thin and broken.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
